newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi, M'bishi Electric scrap DRAM lines--paper.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi, M'bishi Electric scrap DRAM lines--paper.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd is to shut down one of its production lines for 16 megabit dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) chips due to sluggish demand, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday.
The paper said production had already been suspended since last summer at the line at Hitachi's Takasaki plant in northern Japan.
Mitsubishi Electric Corp has also suspended the construction of a new production line for 16 megabit DRAM chips, the paper said.
Spokesmen for the companies were not immediately available to comment on the report.
